_comment: RECORDED outputs of the triage system under test (the 'good' run). In real use these are produced by running the actual model over data/triage-heldout.jsonl; they are committed here as a deterministic fixture so `make eval`/`make demo` run offline in CI without a live LLM. This is a realistically imperfect run: it misses HO-015 (NTLMv1 downgrade, called benign -> a false negative) and over-calls HO-022 (approved USB, called malicious -> a false positive). Swap this file for your real model's output to grade the actual system.
